title: Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control
title_zh: Mimir: 物理导向的大语言模型代理用于长期灌溉控制

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mímir , a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mímir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地将推理、工具使用和行动结合起来，但大多数证据都来自具有相对即时反馈且可重置失败的阶段性任务。 长期运行的物理控制则处于不同的机制中：行动会改变未来状态，错误会在决策中累积，而智能体必须从经验中学习改进，却无法改写确保执行安全的物理规则。 我们通过灌溉系统研究这一机制，其中每日决策会与整个生长季节的土壤-水分动态相互作用。 我们提出了 Mímir——一个基于物理原理的 LLM 智能体，其架构围绕两种修复时间尺度展开。 在快速时间尺度上，一个结构化的物理接口和确定性模拟器会将 LLM 的输出转化为一个提案，我们在执行前对其进行数值验证、修正，并置于有界的确定性行动选择中。 在缓慢时间尺度上，重复出现的失败模式会被整合为持久的上下文原则，从而对未来的提案施加条件，而物理模型、评估器和执行约束则保持不变。 在多个地点、作物和年份中采用统一的回顾性评估器时，Mímir 实现了所评估参考方法中最低的报告总控制成本，且灌溉量比历史方案重播减少了约 51%。 消融研究表明，若移除正向模拟、验证修正或持久上下文，控制成本会上升；模型规模和模型家族研究则显示，增大 LLM 规模并未带来单调的性能提升。 由此得出的经验表明，持久的物理智能体能够将语义推理与有界、基于证据的自我改进相结合，同时将物理真实性和执行器权限保留给显式的数值机制。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as agents that interleave reasoning, tool use, memory, and action Yao et al. (2022) . In embodied settings, language models can ground high-level decisions in perception, affordances, and external tools Ahn et al. (2022) ; Driess et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2022) ; Huang et al. (2023) . However, most agent evaluations remain episodic: a task starts, the agent acts for a finite horizon, and the episode terminates. Persistent physical control is different. Each action changes the state on which later decisions depend; consequences can be delayed; and a locally plausible mistake can persist through the physical system long after the language-model call that produced it. A physical agent must therefore do more than generate a reasonable action. It need to remain grounded in numerical dynamics, repair bad decisions before actuation, and accumulate useful experience without allowing that experience to erode execution safety.

paragraphs.en: Irrigation provides a concrete instance of this regime. A controller repeatedly decides how much water to apply under evolving soil, crop, weather, and forecast conditions. Irrigation changes root-zone water storage and therefore the context for future decisions; excessive application consumes water and can increase drainage, whereas insufficient application can accumulate crop-water deficit Allen et al. (1998) . The effect of today’s decision may only become evident after subsequent evapotranspiration, rainfall, and additional control actions. Physics-based scheduling, model predictive control (MPC), sensor-driven irrigation, and reinforcement learning already provide strong solutions when the state, model, objective, and controller are sufficiently specified Allen et al. (1998) ; Delgoda et al. (2016) ; Garcia et al. (1989) ; Dong et al. (2024) ; Yu et al. (2026) ; Ding & Du (2024) . We therefore do not ask whether an LLM should replace these numerical controllers. We ask a narrower systems-and-learning question: if an LLM is introduced as a reasoning component of a long-running physical controller, which responsibilities can be adaptive and which must remain explicit, numerical, and externally enforceable?

paragraphs.en: This question exposes three coupled challenges. Q1: physical grounding. Language models operate naturally over semantic representations, whereas irrigation is governed by quantities with units, conservation relationships, state transitions, and admissible action bounds. The agent should not be asked to reconstruct these relationships implicitly from prose. Q2: decision repair. A physically feasible action is not necessarily a desirable action. Multiple feasible actions can induce different delayed stress, drainage, and water-use consequences, so a first language-model proposal should be treated as a hypothesis to verify but not a device command. Q3: experience-driven adaptation. Recurrent decision errors may become visible only after repeated operation. A persistent agent should learn from those errors, but learning in a physical system raises an additional governance question: what is allowed to change, and what must remain invariant?
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题揭示了三个相互关联的挑战。Q1：物理基础。 语言模型能够自然地基于语义表示进行操作，而灌溉则由具有单位、守恒关系、状态转换和允许动作边界的物理量所控制。 不应要求智能体从文本中隐式地重构这些关系。Q2：决策修复。 一个在物理上可行的动作并不一定是一个理想的动作。 多个可行的动作可能导致不同的延迟压力、排水和水使用后果，因此语言模型提出的初步方案应被视为需要验证的假设，而非设备指令。 Q3：经验驱动的适应。 重复出现的决策错误可能只有在持续运行之后才会显现出来。 一个持续运行的智能体应当从这些错误中学习，但在物理系统中学习会引发一个额外的治理问题：哪些变化是允许的，而哪些必须保持不变？

paragraphs.en: We present Mímir , a two-timescale, physics-grounded LLM agent that answers these questions by separating reasoning authority from physical authority . At the fast timescale, a deterministic soil-water model converts observations into a structured physical state and feasible action region. The LLM proposes and revises a decision; programmatic simulation exposes the consequences of that proposal; a deterministic selector ranks a bounded candidate set; and runtime assurance retains final execution authority. At the slow timescale, recurring corrections and outcome patterns are distilled into persistent contextual principles that can bias future proposals. Importantly, this adaptation don’t need to modify the transition model, evaluator, action bounds, or execution gate. The LLM therefore contributes contextual interpretation, proposal generation, and revision.

paragraphs.en: Recent continual and self-improving agents increasingly treat memory, prompts, and other framework components as objects that can change from experience without updating model weights Kim et al. (2024) ; Sridhar et al. (2026) ; Ren et al. (2026) ; Feng et al. (2026) . Mímir adopts a deliberately bounded version of this idea: experience may repair future reasoning context, but not the trusted physical substrate. Fast-loop repair ends when verification no longer changes the proposal or its fixed budget is exhausted; slow-loop memory changes only when recurring evidence crosses a configured trigger. We therefore use bounded adaptation . This boundary distinguishes Mímir from language-only refinement Madaan et al. (2023) ; Du et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2026) and from broader self-adaptive physical agents Kaushik et al. paragraphs.en: We evaluate Mímir retrospectively using field-observed data from Michigan, Texas, and Colorado spanning multiple crops and years. In the reported multi-site comparison, Mímir attains an aggregate control cost of 100.94 ± 1.80 100.94\pm 1.80 with 2.58 ± 0.12 2.58\pm 0.12 mm irrigation under the common evaluator, while the historical schedule replay uses 5.32 ± 0.57 5.32\pm 0.57 mm. A separate nine-season sequence exhibits substantial seasonal variation without sustained divergence. That shows the ability of long-horizon operational stability. Finally, performance across the LLM sizes remains in the same broad range across several model families, indicating that the control architecture surrounding the language model materially shapes behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用来自密歇根州、得克萨斯州和科罗拉多州的实地观测数据，对 Mímir 进行了回顾性评估，这些数据涵盖了多种作物和多个年份。 在报告的多地点比较中，Mímir 在通用评估器下的总控制成本为 100.94 ± 1.80 100.94\pm 1.80，灌溉量为 2.58 ± 0.12 2.58\pm 0.12 mm，而历史方案重播则使用了 5.32 ± 0.57 5.32\pm 0.57 mm。 针对特定机制的匹配消融实验表明，当移除正向模拟、经验证的方案修订或持续上下文时，控制成本会更高。 一个独立的九季序列显示出显著的季节性变化，但没有持续的偏离。 这表明了其长期运行稳定性方面的能力。 最后，不同规模的 LLM 在多个模型家族中的性能均保持在相同的大致范围内，这表明围绕语言模型的控制架构对行为具有实质性的影响。

paragraphs.en: Irrigation scheduling is commonly formulated as a physical control problem linking soil-water availability, crop demand, weather forcing, and irrigation actions. FAO-56 provides widely used evapotranspiration and crop-water formulations Allen et al. (1998) ; MPC optimizes future actions under explicit dynamics and constraints Delgoda et al. (2016) ; Garcia et al. (1989) ; and learning-based approaches optimize policies from simulated or observed interaction Yang et al. (2020) ; Ding & Du (2024) ; Kelly & Foster (2021) . These approaches are strong control baselines and, when the control problem is fully specified, do not require language reasoning. Agricultural LLM systems increasingly incorporate sensor and weather context for irrigation advice or decision support Kandamali et al. (2025) ; Yu et al. (2026) . Our question is different: how should a language-model agent participate in repeated closed-loop control when numerical prediction and execution authority must remain explicit?
paragraphs.zh: 灌溉调度通常被表述为一个物理控制问题，该问题将土壤水分可用性、作物需求、天气驱动因素和灌溉行动相互关联。FAO-56 提供了广泛使用的蒸腾作用和作物需水模型 Allen et al. (1998)；MPC 在明确的动态过程和约束条件下优化未来行动 Delgoda et al. (2016)；Garcia et al. (1989)；而基于学习的方法则通过模拟或观察到的交互来优化策略 Yang et al. (2020)；Ding & Du (2024)；Kelly & Foster (2021)。这些方法构成了强大的控制基准，并且在控制问题被完全明确时，无需语言推理。农业 LLM 系统越来越多地整合传感器和天气信息，以提供灌溉建议或决策支持 Kandamali et al. (2025)；Yu et al. (2026)。而我们的问题则有所不同：当数值预测和执行权限必须保持明确时，语言模型智能体应如何参与重复的闭环控制？

paragraphs.en: Grounded agents couple language reasoning to external state, tools, or executable capabilities. SayCan grounds plans in robot affordances Ahn et al. (2022) , PaLM-E incorporates embodied observations Driess et al. (2023) , and ReAct interleaves reasoning with actions and observations Yao et al. (2022) . Iterative methods such as Self-Refine and multi-agent debate revisit an initial generation through critique or interaction Madaan et al. (2023) ; Du et al. (2024) , while VIRF couples an LLM planner to a deterministic logic tutor for verifiable plan repair Wu et al. (2026) . Mímir shares the principle that generative proposals should be externally checked, but continuous physical control imposes a different contract: numerical simulation determines state consequences, deterministic logic ranks bounded actions, and runtime assurance remains independent of language-model agreement.

paragraphs.en: A growing literature studies agents that accumulate experience. Reflexion stores verbal feedback Shinn et al. (2023) , Voyager accumulates reusable skills Wang et al. (2023) , online continual learning has been studied for embodied instruction-following agents Kim et al. (2024) , and experience retrieval improves long-horizon robotic control Sridhar et al. (2026) . Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) treats context as an evolving playbook Zhang et al. (2025) . More recent work frames changes to prompts, memory, tools, or controller frameworks as forms of agent self-improvement Ren et al. (2026) , and proposes broader self-evolving embodied systems that adapt memory, task knowledge, or models over time Feng et al. (2026) . Concurrent physical-agent work similarly investigates self-adaptive crop management with verification and reflection Kaushik et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的文献研究了能够积累经验智能体的相关方法。Reflexion 存储了语言反馈（Shinn 等人，2023），Voyager 积累了可重复使用的技能（Wang 等人，2023），在线持续学习已被应用于具身指令跟随智能体（Kim 等人，2024），而经验检索则提升了长期机器人控制效果（Sridhar 等人，2026）。智能体上下文工程（ACE）将上下文视为一个不断演进的剧本（Zhang 等人，2025）。近期的研究则将提示、记忆、工具或控制器框架的变化视为智能体自我改进的一种形式（Ren 等人，2026），并提出了更广泛的自演化具身系统，这些系统能够随时间调整记忆、任务知识或模型（Feng 等人，2026）。同时进行的物理智能体研究也探讨了通过验证与反思实现自适应作物管理的方法（Kaushik 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Mímir occupies a deliberately narrower point in this design space. It performs no model-weight update, no online world-model revision, and no autonomous relaxation of safety rules. Experience can change only the contextual framework used for future proposals. This boundedness is important in physical control because continual adaptation and runtime assurance solve different problems: the former determines what the agent should remember or reconsider, while the latter determines what it is allowed to execute. Control barrier functions, Simplex-style runtime assurance, and safe RL provide complementary mechanisms for maintaining explicit safety conditions Ames et al. (2019) ; Mehmood et al. (2022) ; Wachi & Sui (2020) . The contribution of Mímir is a two-timescale architecture that permits experience-driven reasoning repair while preserving an immutable numerical control boundary.
paragraphs.zh: Mímir 在此设计空间中占据了一个刻意收窄的节点。 它不会执行模型权重更新、在线世界模型修订，也不会自主放宽安全规则。 经验只能改变未来提案所使用的情境框架。 这种有限性在物理控制中至关重要，因为持续适应和运行时保障解决的是不同问题：前者决定智能体应记住或重新考虑什么，而后者则决定其被允许执行什么。 控制屏障函数、Simplex 风格的运行时保障以及安全强化学习为维持明确的安全条件提供了互补机制 Ames et al. (2019) ; Mehmood et al. (2022) ; Wachi & Sui (2020) 。 Mímir 的贡献是一种双时间尺度架构，它允许基于经验的推理修复，同时保持一个不可更改的数值控制边界。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the central design principle: adaptive reasoning and physical authority are intentionally asymmetric. The language model may propose, explain, and revise. Numerical tools determine predicted consequences. Deterministic logic constrains and ranks actions. Runtime assurance retains final actuator authority. Persistent memory may influence future reasoning, but it cannot expand what the physical controller permits. This creates two repair loops: a fast loop corrects individual proposals using physical evidence, while a slow loop consolidates recurring experience into contextual principles. Neither loop can alter physical state-transition rules or execution constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了核心设计原则：自适应推理与物理权限被有意设计为不对称的。 语言模型可以提出建议、进行解释和修订。 数值工具用于确定预测后果。 确定性逻辑对行动进行约束和排序。 运行时保障保留了最终执行器的权限。 持久化存储可能影响未来的推理，但它无法扩展物理控制器所允许的操作范围。 这形成了两个修复循环：快速循环利用物理证据修正单个建议，而慢速循环则将重复出现的经验整合为情境性原则。 这两个循环都无法改变物理状态转换规则或执行约束。

paragraphs.en: We call this bounded experience-driven adaptation : framework-level self-improvement in which accumulated experience can change future reasoning context, but not model weights, the physical world model, or runtime constraints. The central question is therefore not only whether a physical agent can learn, but which parts are permitted to learn and under what evidence . Appendix H gives the full memory contract.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种有限的经验驱动适应称为：框架层面的自我改进，其中积累的经验可以改变未来的推理上下文，但不能改变模型权重、物理世界模型或运行时约束。 因此，核心问题不仅在于一个物理智能体能否学习，更在于哪些部分被允许学习，以及在何种证据下可以学习。 附录 H 提供了完整的记忆契约。

paragraphs.en: The corpus contains approximately 6,938 days, or 19 crop-years, spanning four environments: Michigan potato under humid, variable rainfall Dong et al. (2024) ; Bushland, Texas maize under high evaporative demand Evett et al. (2024) ; Colorado LIRF maize under limited-irrigation treatments Trout & Bausch (2017) ; and a separate Colorado sunflower sequence for the nine-season analysis Trout et al. (2025) . Available streams include hourly weather forcing, irrigation records, evapotranspiration-related variables, and soil-water observations. Appendix B summarizes their role and describes provenance and preprocessing.
paragraphs.zh: 该语料库包含约 6,938 天，即 19 个作物年，涵盖四种环境：密歇根州在潮湿且降雨量多变的条件下种植的土豆（Dong 等人，2024）；德克萨斯州布什兰县在高蒸腾需求条件下种植的玉米（Evett 等人，2024）；科罗拉多州 LIRF 项目中采用有限灌溉处理的玉米（Trout 与 Bausch，2017）；以及用于九季分析的科罗拉多州独立向日葵序列（Trout 等人，2025）。可用的数据流包括每小时天气驱动数据、灌溉记录、蒸腾作用相关变量以及土壤水分观测数据。附录 B 总结了这些数据的作用，并描述了其来源和预处理过程。

paragraphs.en: For each eligible chronological segment, the first 60% is reserved for calibration or baseline training and the remaining 40% for evaluation; samples are never shuffled. Decisions are issued every 24 h using a 168 h history and a 24 h forward horizon, while the physical model integrates hourly. At time t t , a method can use only information available by that decision time. All methods share the same forecast construction, actuator limits, feasible action bounds, and evaluation window. The protocol forbids future reads, initialization or repair of persistent context from future held-out outcomes, test-based seed selection, and overlap between calibration and evaluation windows. The nine-season sequence preserves chronological order and is analyzed separately from the main aggregate.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个符合条件的时序段，前 60% 保留用于校准或基线训练，其余 40% 用于评估；样本绝不会被打乱。 每 24 小时根据 168 小时的历史数据和 24 小时的前瞻范围做出决策，而物理模型则按小时进行积分。 在时间 t t 时，某种方法只能使用在该决策时刻之前已可用的信息。 所有方法共享相同的预测构建方式、执行器限制、可行动作边界和评估窗口。 该协议禁止从未来预留的结果中读取未来数据、初始化或修复持久化上下文，禁止基于测试集选择种子，也禁止校准窗口与评估窗口之间出现重叠。 这个包含九个季节的序列保持了时序顺序，并且与主聚合数据集分开分析。

paragraphs.en: We report four reference classes. Historical irrigation replays recorded irrigation actions under the common evaluator and serves as a management reference; it is not a comparison of realized crop yield. MAD-50 irrigates after 50% management-allowable depletion and refills toward field capacity subject to the common action limit FAO (2017) . ET-Replace replaces accumulated evapotranspiration loss using the same causal weather information. DRLIC provides the reinforcement-learning reference Ding & Du (2024) . Appendix E additionally describes zero irrigation, fixed-threshold control, and a deterministic physics-search/MPC reference used diagnostically to separate language-conditioned anchoring from numerical action search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了四个参考类别。 历史灌溉重演记录了在通用评估器下的灌溉操作，并作为管理参考；它并非对实际作物产量的比较。 MAD-50 在允许管理的耗水量达到 50% 后进行灌溉，并在通用操作限制 FAO (2017) 的约束下向田间持水量补水。 ET-Replace 使用相同的因果天气信息来补充累积的蒸腾损失。 DRLIC 提供了强化学习参考 Ding & Du (2024)。 附录 E 还描述了零灌溉、固定阈值控制以及一种确定性物理搜索/MPC 参考，该参考被用于诊断性分析，以区分语言条件约束与数值操作搜索。

paragraphs.en: In the evaluation We first ask whether the complete controller attains useful long-horizon performance under a common protocol. We then test the three proposed capabilities in order: physical grounding (Q1), verified decision repair (Q2), and experience-driven adaptation (Q3). Because several component ablations were produced on different matched evaluation slices, each effect is interpreted only against the corresponding full configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估中，我们首先考察完整的控制器是否能在通用协议下实现有益的长期表现。 接着，我们按顺序测试所提出的三项能力：物理基础（Q1）、经验证的决策修复（Q2）以及经验驱动自适应（Q3）。 由于多个组件消融实验是在不同的匹配评估切片上进行的，因此每个效应仅在与相应完整配置对照时进行解读。

paragraphs.en: We presented Mímir , a physics-grounded LLM agent for long-horizon irrigation control. The design begins from a simple premise: persistent physical agents need the ability to adapt, but not every part of a physical controller should be equally free to change. Mímir therefore separates three responsibilities. A structured physical interface defines state and feasible actions; simulator-grounded decision repair lets language-model proposals be challenged with numerical evidence before deterministic selection; and bounded cross-episode context carries recurring experience forward without changing the physical model or execution constraints. Across the reported multi-site and multi-year evaluation, matched ablations show that physical simulation, verified repair, and persistent context each affect control behavior. The resulting contribution shows one way to build a persistent physical agent in which reasoning can evolve from experience while physical truth and actuator authority remain explicitly governed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Mímir，一个基于物理原理的 LLM 智能体，用于长期灌溉控制。 该设计从一个简单的前提出发：持续存在的物理智能体需要适应能力，但物理控制器的每个部分都不应同样自由地改变。 因此，Mímir 将三种职责进行了分离。 一个结构化的物理接口定义了状态和可行的动作；基于模拟器的决策修复机制允许通过数值证据对语言模型的建议进行验证，然后再进行确定性选择；而有限跨回合上下文则能在不改变物理模型或执行约束的前提下，将重复出现的经验延续下去。 在报告的多地点、多年期评估中，相应的消融实验表明，物理模拟、验证性修复和持续上下文各自都会影响控制行为。 这一成果展示了一种构建持续物理智能体的方法：在这种架构中，推理可以基于经验不断演进，同时物理真实性和执行器权限仍受到明确约束。

paragraphs.en: The LLM in Mímir is neither the physical model nor the final optimizer. It maps structured state, forecast, crop-stage information, and persistent guidance to a context-conditioned proposal and can revise that proposal after numerical feedback. Physical rollout evaluates consequences, deterministic selection ranks bounded candidates, and runtime assurance retains final execution authority. The paper therefore studies how adaptive semantic reasoning can be composed with trusted numerical control; it does not establish that an LLM is necessary for every irrigation problem or that it is superior to the best deterministic optimizer.
paragraphs.zh: Mímir 中的 LLM 既不是物理模型，也不是最终的优化器。 它将结构化状态、预测、作物生长阶段信息和持续指导映射到一个上下文相关的提案中，并能在获得数值反馈后修订该提案。 物理执行会评估后果，确定性选择会对有界的候选项进行排序，而运行时保障则保留最终执行权。 因此，本文研究了自适应语义推理如何与可信的数值控制相结合；但并未证明 LLM 对每个灌溉问题都是必需的，也未证明其优于最佳的确定性优化器。

paragraphs.en: Mímir implements scaffold-level, experience-driven adaptation. Persistent principles can change future proposals, but updates are evidence-triggered and cannot modify model weights, the physical transition model, the evaluator, or the feasible-action set. Fast-loop repair terminates when physical verification no longer changes the proposal or the fixed round budget is reached. Slow-loop adaptation is a no-op when no recurring pattern satisfies the configured update trigger. These semantics prevent open-ended reflection from becoming part of actuation.
paragraphs.zh: Mímir 实现了基于经验、以框架为单位的自适应。 持续有效的原则可以改变未来的提案，但更新必须由证据触发，且不能修改模型权重、物理转换模型、评估器或可行动作集。 当物理验证不再改变提案，或达到固定轮次预算时，快速循环修复将终止。 如果没有重复出现的模式满足已配置的更新触发条件，慢速循环自适应将不执行任何操作。 这些语义机制可防止开放式的反思成为执行动作的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Agriculture is a persistent embodied-control problem: actions modify a physical state, feedback is delayed, environmental forcing changes over time, and experience accumulates across repeated interaction Liu et al. (2025a) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2025c) ; Liu et al. (2025b) ; Liu et al. (2026) ; Gan et al. (2023) ..
